old_caption: The video begins with a static close-up view of a vibrant blue liquid, which appears to be ink or paint, on a white surface. The blue color is rich and deep, with subtle variations in shade. After a period of static, a bright yellow splash appears from the right side of the frame. The yellow splash diffuses and expands, changing its shape and intensity. The scene captures the dynamic diffusion and interplay of the two colors, highlighting their evolving forms.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up view of a vibrant blue liquid, which appears to be ink or paint, spreading across a white surface. The blue color is rich and deep, with subtle variations in shade creating a dynamic and fluid appearance. As the video progresses, a bright yellow splash emerges from the right side of the frame, expanding outward and blending with the blue. This yellow splash grows larger and more intense, creating a striking contrast against the blue. The two colors continue to mix and spread, forming an intricate pattern of swirling hues. The scene captures the mesmerizing movement and transformation of the colors, highlighting their interplay and the beauty of their interaction. The video concludes with the two colors fully intertwined, creating a visually captivating and harmonious blend.
caption: Against a bright white background, a feathery blue mass occupies the left side, with darker cobalt pooling near the lower corner and pale cyan tendrils extending outward. The blue region remains largely fixed in place, its edges shifting only subtly as fine wisps diffuse through the bright field. A yellow-orange bloom then becomes visible on the right, presenting a dense central mass surrounded by radiating pale-yellow petals. Its center stays roughly in place while the flower-like footprint enlarges, the petals lengthening and thinning toward the white space. As the yellow mass spreads, the pale gap between it and the blue plumes narrows, bringing the two colored regions closer, a faint greenish blend forming at the boundary. The blue formation continues its slow edge movement throughout, still anchored on the left while its tendrils soften and shift. The yellow bloom remains in active expansion, while the blue plumes continue their slow diffusion.
